insights.one_liner: London-based recruitment firm of about 31 people focused on insurance and financial services, with a pay-transparent English-language entry role in Amsterdam.

culture.text: A small recruitment firm (about 31 staff on LinkedIn, founded 2017) headquartered in London, headhunting for insurance, private equity and hedge funds.
Staff come from UK universities such as Nottingham Trent, Lancaster and Kent, often with languages, politics or business degrees.
Main team functions are consulting, HR, operations and business development, so roles are people- and sales-heavy.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so it cannot sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa.
Its one open job here, an entry-level data role in Amsterdam, needs no Dutch and shows the salary.
Works across London, North American and EMEA markets and pitches itself as having international reach.
